🎮 FREE GAMES ALERT: Epic Games Store is giving away two full titles right now — but the clock runs out tomorrow.

🛸 Alien: Isolation — the acclaimed 2014 survival horror game that drops you on a space station stalked by a single, relentless Xenomorph. One of the most tense stealth-horror games ever made.
🏴‍☠️ Mark of the Deep — a pirate-themed metroidvania adventure about a sailor shipwrecked on a mysterious cursed island.

Both are yours to keep forever if claimed before the swap on November 26, 2026 — together worth around $59.

🕒 Posted: 25 Nov 2026, 11:58 GMT+3

📰 Sources: Epic Games Store

👥 x.com/EpicGames

💬 Which one are you claiming before time runs out?

#EpicGames #FreeGames #PCGaming #Gaming #GamingNews
